EIRP 以点源为参照、ERP 以半波偶极子为参照：EIRP = ERP × 1: EIRP is referenced to a point source and ERP to a half-wave dipole: EIRP = ERP × 1.64 (+2.15 dB). Example: an antenna rated 8.15 dBi has 6.5 times the power gain of a point source, and 6 dBd = 4.0 times that of a half-wave dipole.
HF 水平天线的标称增益常常「含地面反射」。同一副偶极子架在理想大地上方 0.1: The quoted gain of an HF horizontal antenna often includes the ground reflection. For the same dipole at 0.125–1 wavelength (7 heights) above perfect ground, the maximum gain is 4.8–6.9 dB higher than in free space; over average ground (εr = 13, σ = 5 mS/m, reflection-coefficient approximation) it is 3.2–5.6 dB (necpp, 14.2 MHz). When a manufacturer writes just "x dBi" without saying whether the ground is included, that figure cannot be compared directly with a free-space value.
IEEE Std 145 定义的增益不含阻抗失配与极化失配；「实现增益」把阻抗失: The gain defined in IEEE Std 145 excludes impedance and polarisation mismatch; "realised gain" also includes impedance mismatch and depends on the system the antenna is connected to. An antenna with a poor SWR can have a high gain and a low realised gain.
LPDA 的单位长度增益低于八木，换来整个频带内增益与驻波比都比较平坦：一副按: An LPDA gives less gain per unit length than a Yagi, in return for gain and SWR that stay fairly flat across the whole band: one LPDA designed for 14–28 MHz covers the 20 / 17 / 15 / 12 m bands and the part of 10 m below 28 MHz (set the design limit to 29.7 MHz to cover all of 10 m); a Yagi has better gain and front-to-back ratio over a narrow band.
NEC 建模时，单个频率上的并联 LC 就是一个纯电抗，可以换成该频率下电抗相同: In an NEC model, a parallel LC at a single frequency is just a pure reactance and can be replaced by a series element with the same reactance at that frequency (this is how the site's trap calculator checks itself).
dBi 以各向同性辐射器（理想点源）为参照，dBd 以自由空间中的半波偶极子为参: dBi is referenced to an isotropic radiator (an ideal point source) and dBd to a half-wave dipole in free space; the half-wave dipole itself is 2.15 dBi, so dBi = dBd + 2.15 (necpp: a thin-wire dipole has a maximum gain of 2.14 dBi). For the same antenna, the dBi figure is always 2.15 larger than the dBd figure.
¼ 波长垂直振子靠地面（或地网）充当另一半：理想大地上它等价于「振子 + 镜像」: A quarter-wave vertical uses the ground (or the radial system) as its other half: over perfect ground it is equivalent to a half-wave dipole made of the radiator plus its image, so the feed-point resistance is half that of the dipole and the gain is 3 dB higher. Checked with necpp at 14.2 MHz: dipole 72.1 Ω / 2.14 dBi, vertical over perfect ground 36.0 Ω / 5.15 dBi, resistance ratio 0.500, gain difference +3.01 dB.
τ 大：振子多、增益与阻抗更平坦；σ 大：臂长变长，增益随之升高，直到最佳 σ: Larger τ: more elements and flatter gain and impedance. Larger σ: a longer boom and more gain, up to the optimum σ. Cebik gives the range 0.8 ≤ τ ≤ 0.98 and 0.03 ≤ σ ≤ σ_opt; amateurs often pick a smaller σ, trading some gain for a shorter boom.
为振子底端的回流电流提供低电阻通路。地网不足时电流改走大地，大地电阻与辐射电阻串: They give the return current at the base of the radiator a low-resistance path. With too few radials the current goes through the earth instead; the earth resistance is in series with the radiation resistance and simply turns power into heat: efficiency = radiation resistance ÷ (radiation resistance + ground-loss resistance). With a ground loss equal to the 36 Ω radiation resistance, only 50% (−3 dB) is left.
也可以让陷阱谐振在两个波段之间：低波段用它的感抗、高波段用它的容抗，各自凑出一个: A trap can also be resonant between the two bands: on the low band use its inductive reactance, on the high band its capacitive reactance, each to make up a resonant length (the two-band loaded dipole in the ARRL Handbook supplemental files uses this idea). Trap losses are lower that way, but the antenna's bandwidth does not get wider.
任一频率上只有长度接近半波长的那几根振子在有效辐射，其余起引向或反射作用。换频率: At any frequency only the few elements close to a half wavelength radiate effectively; the others act as directors or reflectors. When the frequency changes the active region moves along the antenna, so gain and impedance vary little over a very wide band.
先调陷阱、后调天线：用天线分析仪或栅流表单独找出陷阱的并联谐振点，再装上去修外段: Tune the trap first and the antenna second: find the trap's parallel resonance on its own with an antenna analyser or a grid-dip meter, then fit it and trim the outer section.
先量馈点电阻：把天线调到谐振后用天线分析仪读 R。接近 36 Ω 说明地网基本合: Measure the feed-point resistance first: tune the antenna to resonance and read R with an antenna analyser. Close to 36 Ω means the radial system is roughly adequate; clearly higher with a very nice SWR is most likely ground loss at work.
内段取高波段的半波；高波段上陷阱谐振，外段被隔离。低波段上陷阱呈感性，相当于给天: The inner section is a half wave for the high band; on the high band the trap is resonant and the outer section is isolated. On the low band the trap is inductive and loads the antenna, so the total length of the two sections can be shorter than a straight wire for that frequency (ARRL QST, November 1996, Lab Notes). The trap-dipole calculator under Tools works out the outer length this way and checks it with NEC.
双波段偶极子怎么工作: How a two-band trap dipole works
取 τ = 0.90、σ = 0.16，B = 2：cot α = 4σ ÷ (: Take τ = 0.90, σ = 0.16, B = 2: cot α = 4σ ÷ (1 − τ) = 6.40, α = 8.9°; B_ar = 1.59, B_s = 3.19; N = 12.0, so 12 elements; the longest element is about a half wave at 14 MHz, 10.7 m; the boom is L = (λ_max ÷ 4)(1 − 1/B_s)·cot α = 23.5 m. With σ reduced to 0.05, cot α = 2.0, the boom shrinks to 6.4 m, and N = 9.7, so 10 elements.
地网不足时同轴电缆的外皮会充当地网：馈线上出现共模电流，方向图变形，接收时还会把: With too few radials the outer braid of the coax becomes the radial system: common-mode current appears on the feed line, the pattern is distorted, and noise is brought into the receiver. Put a common-mode choke at the feed point and add radials.
地网抬离地面、按谐振长度剪，只要少量几根就能把大地损耗压得很低；代价是要有支撑，: Radials lifted off the ground and cut to resonance need only a few wires to bring the ground loss very low; the price is the supports, and a separate set for each band. Cut them to a quarter wavelength, about 71.5 ÷ frequency (MHz) metres (the same basis as the quarter-wave formula in the Formula reference), then trim for resonance.
地网贴地或埋在浅土里时靠根数取胜。美国 FCC 对调幅广播的要求是：至少 90: Radials laid on the ground or buried in shallow soil win by number. The US FCC requires, for AM broadcast, at least 90 evenly spaced buried radials at least a quarter wavelength long, and calls 120 radials of 0.35–0.4 wavelength an excellent system (47 CFR §73.189(b)(4)). Amateur stations cannot reach that scale, but the direction is the same: with the same amount of wire, more shorter radials are generally considered better than a few long ones.
地网越差，馈点电阻越高、驻波比反而「变好」：36 Ω 的辐射电阻串上 14 Ω: The worse the radials, the higher the feed-point resistance and the better the SWR looks: a 36 Ω radiation resistance plus 14 Ω of ground loss is exactly 50 Ω, an SWR of 1.00, yet the efficiency is only 72%. A good SWR does not mean high efficiency; judge the radial system by how far the feed-point resistance sits above 36 Ω, or by comparing real signal strength.
垂直极化的低仰角优势依赖地面：海水边与导电好的土壤最好，城市里的硬化地面最差。: The low-angle advantage of vertical polarisation depends on the ground: best next to salt water and on conductive soil, worst on hard-surfaced city ground.
外段先留长，从最高波段开始往低波段调：每改一段只看那一个波段的谐振。: Leave the outer section long and tune from the highest band downward: each change is judged only on the resonance of that one band.
天线是无源器件，增益只是把能量集中到某些方向：增益 = 方向性 × 效率（IEE: An antenna is a passive device; gain just concentrates energy in some directions: gain = directivity × efficiency (IEEE Std 145: for a lossless antenna the gain equals the directivity). A directional antenna of 8 dBi is necessarily weaker than a point source in other directions.
屋顶、车载这类没法铺地的场合，用多根抬高的谐振地网，或把天线改成端馈并在馈点加共: Where you cannot lay radials (rooftops, vehicles), use several elevated resonant radials, or make the antenna end-fed and put a common-mode choke at the feed point.
扇形偶极子：几根不同长度的导线并联在同一个馈点，每根对应一个波段；谐振的那根阻抗: Fan dipole: several wires of different lengths in parallel at the same feed point, one per band; the resonant one presents close to 50–75 Ω and the detuned ones a much higher impedance, so the total stays close to that of a single resonant wire. Jumpered dipole: short the insulators band by band, with the lowest loss and no bandwidth penalty, but you have to walk to the antenna to change band. Then there is a tuner with open-wire feed line.
手里没有已知增益的天线时，用三副天线两两互测（固定距离，共三次），解三个方程得出: When you have no antenna of known gain, measure three antennas against each other in pairs (fixed distance, three measurements) and solve three equations for the gain of each; transmitting and receiving roles can be swapped.
振子长度与间距按同一个比例缩放：τ = L(n+1) ÷ L(n) < 1 是相: Element lengths and spacings scale by the same ratio: τ = L(n+1) ÷ L(n) < 1 is the length ratio of adjacent elements, and σ = d(n) ÷ (2·L(n)) is the relative spacing (d is the spacing between adjacent elements). All element tips lie on the two edges of one wedge, whose half apex angle α satisfies tan α = (1 − τ) ÷ (4σ).
效率看馈点电阻，不看驻波比: Efficiency shows in the feed-point resistance, not in the SWR
最长振子取低端频率的半波长（实际略长），最短振子要比高端频率再留余量 —— 结构: Make the longest element a half wave at the low-end frequency (a little longer in practice) and leave margin beyond the high-end frequency for the shortest element — the extra in the structure bandwidth B_s is that margin.
本站求解器不支持交叉线 TL（见 NEC 页的说明），所以这里不提供 LPDA: The site's solver does not support crossed transmission lines (TL) (see the note on the NEC page), so no NEC model of an LPDA is provided here.
每个波段都要有对应长度的地网：只给 20 米配的地网，用到 40 米上等于地网不: Every band needs radials of the matching length: radials built for 20 m used on 40 m are too few radials in effect.
比较两副天线先统一参照：dBd 加 2.15 再与 dBi 比。: Put two antennas on the same reference before comparing them: add 2.15 to a dBd figure, then compare it with a dBi figure.
活动区自己占一段带宽：B_ar = 1.1 + 7.7(1 − τ)²·cot: The active region occupies a bandwidth of its own: B_ar = 1.1 + 7.7(1 − τ)²·cot α (a fit to Carrel's 1961 curves). The structure (longest to shortest element) must cover B_s = B × B_ar, where B is highest frequency ÷ lowest frequency; the number of elements is N = 1 + ln(B_s) ÷ ln(1/τ), rounded up when the fractional part exceeds about 0.3 (the Carrel / Cebik procedure).
测量距离要在远场：R > 2D² ÷ λ（D 为天线最大尺寸）。方向性强的天线、: The measurement distance must be in the far field: R > 2D² ÷ λ (D is the largest dimension of the antenna). For highly directive antennas, or when an accurate figure is needed, the distance must be even larger, and the effect of proximity coupling must be checked.
用已知增益的参考天线（标准增益天线，或校准过的半波偶极子）与被测天线轮流接收同一: Let a reference antenna of known gain (a standard-gain antenna, or a calibrated half-wave dipole) and the antenna under test take turns receiving the same source, at the same distance and with the same transmitted power: the reading difference plus the reference gain is the gain under test; with a half-wave dipole as the reference, the result is directly in dBd.
相邻振子交叉馈电（沿馈线每过一个振子交换一次接法，相邻振子相位差 180°）；波: Adjacent elements are fed with a crossover (the connection is swapped at every element along the feed line, so adjacent elements are 180° out of phase); the beam points toward the end with the shortest elements (the apex).
相邻振子的接线接反（没有交叉）会让方向图和驻波比明显变坏；调试时先用天线分析仪扫: Wiring adjacent elements the wrong way (without the crossover) visibly degrades the pattern and the SWR; when testing, sweep the whole band with an antenna analyser first — the SWR should be smooth.
看增益数字先问参照：dBi 还是 dBd？含不含地面？是最大值还是水平面的值？: When you see a gain figure, first ask for its reference: dBi or dBd? Is the ground included? Is it the maximum, or the value in the horizontal plane?
线圈匝间电容、外壳与导线之间的电容都与陷阱并联，会把谐振点往低处拉；设计时 C: Capacitance between coil turns and between the housing and the wire sits in parallel with the trap and pulls its resonance lower; enter the total capacitance, stray included, when designing.
线圈电阻带来损耗，带宽变窄，重量和风阻增加，造价与维护成本上升。陷阱让天线变短、: Coil resistance brings loss, the bandwidth narrows, weight and wind load increase, and cost and maintenance go up. Traps make the antenna shorter and more convenient, but they do not make it better (the conclusion of the same Lab Notes).
自己测对比增益时，用同高度、同距离、同极化，先后换天线做 A/B 比较，重复几次: When measuring comparative gain yourself, use the same height, the same distance and the same polarisation, swap the antennas for an A/B comparison, and repeat a few times to see the spread; do not measure in the near field.
自由空间里 4 根 ¼ 波长地网水平伸出时，馈点电阻只有约 23 Ω；让地网向下: In free space, four quarter-wave radials sticking out horizontally give a feed-point resistance of only about 23 Ω; tilting them downward raises it: about 43 Ω at 30°, about 53 Ω at 45°, about 60 Ω at 60° (necpp, with the vertical already tuned to resonance). So radials drooping about 45° can feed 50 Ω coax directly. This is the free-space result; close to the ground the numbers change with the soil.
阻抗失配（先测 S11、做失配修正）、馈线损耗与电缆晃动、极化不匹配（线极化对圆: Impedance mismatch (measure S11 first and correct for it), feed-line loss and cable movement, polarisation mismatch (a linear antenna against a circular one costs a fixed 3 dB), ground reflections and nearby objects, and quantisation of the reading level. The approach matches the Measurement Lab: estimate a range for each item and combine them into an uncertainty.
陷阱是并联的电感和电容，谐振频率 f₀ = 1/(2π√(LC))。在 f₀ 处: A trap is an inductor and a capacitor in parallel, resonant at f₀ = 1/(2π√(LC)). At f₀ its impedance is very high, acting as a frequency-dependent insulator that cuts off the outer section; below f₀ it is inductive, above f₀ capacitive.
陷阱谐振时两端电压很高：电容耐压与线圈温升要按功率选，不要只看标称电容值。: A resonant trap has high voltage across it: choose the capacitor voltage rating and coil temperature rise for the power, not just the nominal capacitance.
高度小于 ¼ 波长的垂直振子，辐射电阻随（高度 ÷ 波长）² 急剧下降，要用加载: For a vertical shorter than a quarter wavelength, the radiation resistance falls rapidly with (height ÷ wavelength)², and a loading coil must cancel the capacitive reactance. A coil in the middle of the radiator is better than one at the base, and a capacitive top hat is better still; see the short-antenna loading-coil calculator under Tools for an estimate.
